svg.title: Figure 3 | NFS attaches a remote file system to the local directory tree
svg.desc: The dashed arrow represents client-to-server read/write requests, not copying the entire dataset locally. Replies, caching and protocol details are omitted. Mounting does not grant access to every file.

g.text: Figure 3 | NFS attaches a remote file system to the local directory tree
The dashed arrow represents client-to-server read/write requests, not copying the entire dataset locally
. Replies, caching and protocol details are omitted. Mounting does not grant access to every file.
